1.w: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim,

2.w: [that] they made war with Bera king of Sodom, and Birsha king of Gomorrah, [and] Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that [is], Zoar).

3.w: All these joined together in the Valley of Siddim (that [is], the Salt Sea).

4.w: Two [and] ten years they had served Chedorlaomer, and in the three and tenth year they rebelled.

5.w: And in the four and tenth year came Chedorlaomer and the kings who [were] with him, and they struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, and the Zuzites in Ham, and the Emites in Shaveh-kiriathaim,

6.w: and the Horites in their mountain of Seir, as far as El-Paran, which [is] by the wilderness.

7.w: And they turned back and came to En-mishpat (that [is], Kadesh), and they struck all the territory of the Amalekite, and also the Amorite who was dwelling in Hazazon-tamar.

8.w: And the king of Sodom went out, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that [is], Zoar). And they arrayed in battle with them in the Valley of Siddim—

9.w: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against the five.

10.w: And the Valley of Siddim had pits, pits of tar; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and [some] fell there, and the remainder fled to the mountains.

11.w: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food, and they went on their way.

12.w: And they took Lot, son of Abram's brother, and his goods, and they departed; and he was dwelling in Sodom.

13.w: And the escapee came, and he told Abram the Hebrew, and he was dwelling by the Oaks of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner; and they were possessors [of] a covenant with Abram.

14.w: And Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, and he drew out his trained men, those born in his house, eight [and] ten and three hundred, and he went in pursuit as far as Dan.

15.w: And he divided himself against them by night—he and his servants—and he struck them and he pursued them as far as Hobah, which [is] north of Damascus.

16.w: And he brought back all the goods, and also Lot, his brother, and his goods; he also brought back the women and the people.

17.w: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from striking Chedorlaomer and the kings who [were] with him at the Valley of Shaveh (that [is], the King’s Valley).

18.w: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine, and he [was] priest of El-Elyon.

19.w: And he blessed him and said: “Blessed be Abram to El-Elyon, Possessor of the heavens and earth,

20.w: and blessed be El-Elyon, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” And he gave to him a tenth of everything.

21.w: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give to me the souls, and take the goods for yourself.”

22.w: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have raised my hand to YHWH El-Elyon, Possessor of the heavens and earth,

23.w: from a thread even to a strap of a sandal, that I will [not] take anything that [is] yours—lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’—

24.w: Except only what the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They may take their portion.”
